evidence.quote: following changes have been done for settlement of claims out of inoperative accounts

relationships.scope: Changes who may settle claims out of inoperative accounts and the amount limits after the Section Supervisor delegation; the 2011 Account Officer limit is not stated to be withdrawn for other cases. Amounts are in the original text.
The 2014 circular builds on the 5 March 2012 delegation of financial powers to Section Supervisors; it does not replace that delegation.

limitations: This collection concerns who may settle or authorise EPF claims and where claim work is processed (delegated powers, limits, designated offices). It is not the procedure for filing a claim and not about claim rejection reasons.

Rupee limits are in the original circulars and have changed over time; a later circular for the same matter is not assumed to withdraw an earlier one unless it says so. The 2014 inoperative-accounts circular changes the limits for settlement out of inoperative accounts without stating that the 2011 delegation is withdrawn.

Multi-Location Claim Settlement (MLC) lets claims be settled by a Collaborating Regional Office (CRO). The 2021 circular delegates the role of assigning CRO under MLC to Zonal ACCs within their jurisdictions; it does not state when the arrangement ends. The 2023 circular records Executive Committee approval (10 March 2023) for claim settlement by Special State Offices; the date shown is the issue date, not the commencement.

The 2016 and 2017 PF member name-correction delegations are included here as member-data powers (the 2017 letter is dated 31 October although its receipt stamp is 1 November). The Joint Declaration and Aadhaar process documents that later governed name correction live in the JD and Member profile / Aadhaar policies; no supersession is inferred.

Delegation of financial powers for the settlement of claims in closed establishments and for exceptional transactions (2012, 2017, 2021, 2025) was moved here from the administrative and financial powers collection; those documents are unchanged.

PDFs for entries marked compiled_copy were read from a compilation of circulars (Delegation_Circulars_Combined.pdf); its hash identifies the compilation, not a public original, and the app does not offer a download for them. Scanned pages are OCR.
